lines.speaker: Breeze
lines.text: Ah, the new addition. Come, sit, have a drink — I insist, and you'll find I'm quite persuasive.

lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: Is that brass talking, or just you?

lines.speaker: Breeze
lines.text: Both, dear girl, always both. A Soother who can't charm a room on his own merits is a poor Soother indeed.
